say:3:1012508001:0.text: Everyone read the letter, right? This was indeed Eomir's hiding place. He's injured and needs protection. That's why the Adamant Syndicate was here.
say:3:1012508001:0.source_cn: 信件大家都看过了吧……这里的确是伊米尔的藏身处，他在这...

say:4:1012508002:1.text: Don't leave out the key piece of information. The reward that Eomir promised them was the land here. I'm afraid that this place has already become a testing ground for the Adamant Syndicate.
say:4:1012508002:1.source_cn: 别落下关键信息，伊米尔承诺的酬劳是这片土地，恐怕……这...

say:5:1012508003:1.text: He has no right to do this!

say:6:1012508004:1.text: Selling our precious land to grove killers... How many more lies will Eomir continue to tell?
say:6:1012508004:1.source_cn: 出卖土地给黑金商会，万人敬仰的伊米尔大贤者到底还有多少谎言？

say:7:1012508005:0.text: Selling our land for protection... he must be badly hurt.
say:7:1012508005:0.source_cn: 如此酬劳换来的守卫，看样子他伤得不轻。

say:10:1012508006:1.text: Ha! I've got you now! You can't escape from me!
say:10:1012508006:1.source_cn: 嘎哈！被我抓到了！这下你们跑不了了！

say:11:1012508007:1.text: I like your bunny ears. I think I'll make a good luck charm out of them once I'm done with you.
say:11:1012508007:1.source_cn: 你们的耳朵真可爱啊，只可惜，你们很快就要成为我的下酒菜了！

say:12:1012508008:1.text: Eomir shouldn't be far. We need to give chase now.
say:12:1012508008:1.source_cn: 伊米尔应该跑不远，我们尽快追击。

say:13:1012508009:1.text: By the way, doesn't anyone want to comment on Eomir's terrible handwriting? I hadn't realized until now, but his handwriting is so horrendous.
say:13:1012508009:1.source_cn: 还有……就没人吐槽下伊米尔的字迹吗？没想到写在耀光信纸...

say:16:1012508010:1.text: At least we were able to read it.
say:16:1012508010:1.source_cn: 能看懂说明还是练过的。

say:17:1012508011:1.text: <shk>Bloody fursacks!</shk> How dare you ignore me!

say:18:1012508012:1.text: It's getting a bit too noisy. Let's quiet this fellow.
